description: To the payload corresponding JSON schema file is `WellKnownKNX.json`

supportedversions.description: Additional supported (older) API versions if any. If expressed the included members are mandatory.

links.description: References to API entry points (from this API and vendor specific).

href.description: Relative URL resource path of an useful API entry point, the final URL depends from the API version/ base member.

rel.description: A similar meaning as the rel attribute on HTML, used to express a machine-readable meaning/type of the (href) link

typedescription.description: Absolute URL reference to a extended description for this API entry point.

contenttype.description: Content-Type of the - by _href_ - described API entry point. For the current API only one is specified.

templates.description: URI-Template, defining **each** in the URL used varspec variable

context.description: In the API used IRIs and its namespace prefix definitions.

prefix.description: Defines the namespace prefix as it used in the API (excluding the :).

iri.description: Defines the IRI/URL of the namespace prefix.
